description: Poll the status of an asynchronous operation (e.g. a scale or restart returns an operation to track). Scalingo API: GET /v1/apps/{app}/operations/{operation_id}. Returns { operation } with status pending|running|done|error.

app.description: The app name (e.g. my-production-app) or app id (app-…).

operation_id.description: The operation id (returned in the Location header of a scale/restart response).

name: get_operation
title: Get an operation
